page.notes: Printed page with the running head "INDEX." and no printed page number. The catchword "Pietas" stands at the lower right; the small "6" before it is a verse mark. Verse numbers are the leftmost cell of each entry; page references are the rightmost cell, and wrapped lines of one entry are kept as separate lines. The page reference "15" on the entry "Qui cum iustitiam dei non cognouiscent" is hard to see on the scan. The reading "dn" in "funt dn multi" is uncertain. Long s is plain s throughout; the Greek and Hebrew are absent.
